Has Mat finally lost the plot? This week on Carwow, we’ve added one of the rarest cars in the UK to the fleet: the Mia C. It’s a tiny, French electric car built between 2011 and 2013 that is actually rarer than a Ferrari F40! Only 1,000 were ever made before the company went bust.

With only 11 registered on UK roads, Mat sets out to discover if this central-seat micro-car is a misunderstood genius or a total waste of money!

So what exactly is the Mia C? Unlike the Citroën Ami, the Mia C is classified as an actual car, meaning you can drive it on motorways. It features:
- McLaren F1 Layout: A three-seat configuration with the driver positioned in the centre.
- Bizarre Entry: No traditional door handles! You have to press the flower logo to release the electric latch for the sliding doors.
- Performance (or lack thereof): With a choice of 8kWh or 12kWh batteries, it’s "supposed" to have a range of up to 78
title: My new daily is NOT what you expect
